name: mETH Protocol
description: Permissionless ETH liquid staking run by Mantle. Stake ETH for mETH on Ethereum, queue an unstake request for ETH, and claim it once finalized. mETH is also bridged to Mantle as METHL2.

keyFunctions.description: Stake ETH (msg.value) and mint mETH to msg.sender. Argument: minimum mETH expected, reverts below it (slippage guard). Reverts below minimumDepositAmount().

Start an unstake: takes mETH from msg.sender (approve mETH to Staking first) and opens a request. Arguments: mETH amount and minimum ETH expected. Returns the request ID. Wait for finalization before claiming.
Same as unstakeRequest, using an EIP-2612 permit for the mETH approval. Arguments: mETH amount, minimum ETH, permit deadline, v, r, s.
Claim the ETH of a finalized unstake request by its ID. Reverts until the request is finalized.
Returns (bool finalized, uint256 ETH amount) for a request ID.
mETH minted for an ETH amount at the current rate (before any adjustment).
ETH value of an mETH amount at the current rate.
Total ETH controlled by the protocol, in wei.
Minimum ETH per stake, in wei.
Minimum mETH per unstake request.
True if staking is restricted to an allowlist.
Exchange adjustment rate (uint16) that can lower the mETH minted per ETH. Check the mETH docs for its meaning.

Full request record for an ID: requester, mETH amount, ETH amounts and cumulative checkpoints (6 fields).
Blocks that must pass before a request can be finalized. The docs give a minimum wait of 12 hours, and longer when the queue is busy.

actions.name: stake ETH for mETH
actions.description: Mint mETH from ETH on Ethereum
actions.how: Staking.stake(minMETH) with ETH value; check minimumDepositAmount() first

actions.name: unstake mETH
actions.how: approve mETH to Staking, then Staking.unstakeRequest(mETHAmount, minETH) or unstakeRequestWithPermit; keep the returned request ID

actions.name: claim unstake
actions.description: Receive ETH for a finalized request
actions.how: check Staking.unstakeRequestInfo(id) returns finalized = true, then Staking.claimUnstakeRequest(id)

actions.name: value mETH
actions.description: Get the ETH value of mETH

risks: Unstaking is queued. The docs give a minimum wait of 12 hours, and the wait can run to 40 days or more when the Ethereum validator exit queue is long.
Unstake requests are finalized in order, so a large request can delay smaller ones behind it.
The protocol can restrict staking to an allowlist (isStakingAllowlist). Check it before sending ETH.
The exchange adjustment rate can reduce the mETH minted for a deposit. Read exchangeAdjustmentRate() and ethToMETH() before staking.
Core contracts are upgradeable proxies under Mantle governance and role-based admin keys.
The Mantle copy of mETH is a bridged token. Its value depends on the bridge, so check the bridge before relying on it.
notes: Ethereum mainnet contracts from the Mantle LSP README (mantle-lsp/contracts, L1 table), with METHL2 from its L2 table. Staking, METH and the rest of the L1 table are proxies (EIP-1967 slot checked on chain). The Ethereum cmETH restaking token is a separate product and is not covered. Mantle docs give the full protocol details at docs.mantle.xyz/meth.
